The '''Holopix News photographer assassin''' was a member of an unknown [[Species/Legends|species]]. He was a member of the [[Assassin's Guild/Legends|Assassin's Guild]].

==Biography==
During [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] first term as an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]], she was sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Challon]]. [[Emir (human)|Emir]] hired the [[Assassin's Guild/Legends|Assassin's Guild]] to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] Leia. This assassin impersonated a [[Journalist/Legends|reporter]] from the [[Holopix News]] and attempted to assassinate Leia. Before he had the chance, [[Giles Durane]] and [[Gimlet]] killed him.<ref name="The Weapons Master!" />
